architecture_summary: OWASP Juice Shop - A deliberately insecure full-stack web application for security training and CTF competitions. Built with Express.js backend, Angular frontend, and MongoDB. Contains intentionally vulnerable code patterns across multiple security challenge categories including SQL injection, XSS, authentication bypass, CSRF, and Web3 vulnerabilities. Designed to teach web application security through practical exploitation challenges.
key_patterns: JWT-based authentication with intentional bypass vulnerabilities
Mongoose ODM with NoSQL injection vectors
